leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Import the useEffect hook into React components to manage side effects
Implement useEffect with an empty dependency array to execute code only on component mount
Configure useEffect with dependencies to trigger re-execution when specific values change
Apply cleanup functions within useEffect to prevent memory leaks and cancel subscriptions
Construct useEffect hooks that update component state based on external data changes
Control when side effects execute by manipulating the dependency array values
Integrate multiple useEffect hooks within a single component to handle different side effects
Initialize data fetching operations using useEffect to populate component state on mount
